```{r}
library(shiny)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# Load files
council <- st_read("D:/Documents/00-Personal/01-FHTW/SS2026/MAD-BB-2-SS2026-SOE-R/99-Project-SolutionEngineering/data/Pierce_County_Council_Districts_8934877056349991897.geojson")

zipcodes <- st_read("D:/Documents/00-Personal/01-FHTW/SS2026/MAD-BB-2-SS2026-SOE-R/99-Project-SolutionEngineering/data/Zip Codes.geojson")

# Transform to WGS84
council <- st_transform(council, 4326)
zipcodes <- st_transform(zipcodes, 4326)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Pierce County Map"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Selected information"),
      verbatimTextOutput("click_info")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      leafletOutput("map", height = 700)
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%

      addPolygons(
        data = zipcodes,
        group = "ZIP Codes",
        color = "gray",
        weight = 1,
        fillOpacity = 0.15
      ) %>%

      addPolygons(
        data = council,
        group = "Districts",
        layerId = ~District_Number,
        color = "red",
        weight = 2,
        fillOpacity = 0.30,
        popup = ~paste0(
          "<b>District</b><br>",
          "District: ", District_Number
        )
      ) %>%

      addLayersControl(
        overlayGroups = c("ZIP Codes", "Districts"),
        options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
      )
  })

  # Click on Council District polygon:
  # returns district + coordinates
  observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, {
    click <- input$map_shape_click

    output$click_info <- renderText({
      paste0(
        "Council District selected\n",
        "District: ", click$id, "\n",
        "Latitude: ", round(click$lat, 6), "\n",
        "Longitude: ", round(click$lng, 6)
      )
    })
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)

  # Click outside polygon:
  # returns only coordinates
  observeEvent(input$map_click, {
    click <- input$map_click

    output$click_info <- renderText({
      paste0(
        "Coordinates selected\n",
        "Latitude: ", round(click$lat, 6), "\n",
        "Longitude: ", round(click$lng, 6)
      )
    })
  }, ignoreInit = TRUE)
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
